coordinated_route_hunt.public_wording:
Together defeat both Green Legooms on the eastern hunting route and return alive to the starting stone arch.
One opponent is along the passage east of camp; the other is in the yard at its far end. Your positions and views differ. Choose whether to approach together or split up, and coordinate recovery and return as needed. Damage from either teammate counts; equal contributions are not required.
Both players must finish standing still on the ground at the arch.
Each player's initial native respawn waypoint is their own starting position. Death does not restore enemies, equipment or the time budget.

native_contract_settlement.public_wording:
Accept the guard's native monster-slaying contract, defeat its designated target after acceptance, and return to the giver to receive the actual coin reward.
The guard begins near the starting camp; the monster starts in the northern yard beyond the stone arch. Follow the actual offer and any later movement. The benchmark supplies the giver with 3000 coins before play to fund native offers; the monster-slaying reward remains 1000 coins; no contract is accepted for you.
Finish alive, standing still on the ground beside the giver after receiving payment.
Offers can vary between conversations; unrelated delivery or escort jobs do not satisfy the monster-slaying objective. The initial native respawn waypoint is your starting camp. Death does not revive NPCs, cancel quests, repair equipment or reset the time budget.

route_schema_transfer.public_wording:
Explore the first three-module wing, then traverse two application wings and finish alive and stationary at the centre of the final enlarged chamber. Complete the route without dying or respawning.
Each module has one, two or three shallow niches in the wall beside its entrance. Within this instance, a given niche pattern always has the same continuing exit side relative to the direction in which you enter. One branch continues; the other ends at a solid wall. Learn the architecture through ordinary exploration.
After the first wing, descend the connecting staircase. Later wings rearrange the module order and rotate their orientation. Reuse what you discovered; an absolute compass direction or blindly replaying the first turn sequence will not suffice.
The two application wings together allow at most 344 metres of sampled native travel, including detours and backtracking. Practice travel and connecting stairs are outside that distance allowance, but still consume episode time. All movement remains ordinary native movement; there are no modified controls, recipes or physics. Complete the application wings in order and remain in the final chamber.

wrapper_semantics.team: Only non-peer_support team encounters inherit all.min_health (default 1). Both owner combat and every participant alive gate receive the same floor; role/any/higher-reserve checks remain additional requirements. No peer_support API expansion.
wrapper_semantics.route: validate_route, evaluate_route and route_transfer_checks accept/forward explicit min_health, default 1. No route/2 identity, counter, history, travel, deaths or sampling changes.
wrapper_semantics.downed: Native survival.health.downed=true now explicitly rejects state-based success even at positive HP. Prior source did not check this flag; this is a coupled tightening, not a claim that old scoring already rejected every downed endpoint.

compatibility_limits: Zero min_health still requires strictly positive finite HP; native dead and downed flags reject success.
Default 1 remains for omitted floors; explicit reserve goals (including both 75HP tasks) remain unchanged.
Missing downed flags retain older-snapshot compatibility; absence is not evidence that the player was not downed.
The downed-flag guard affects all state_checks callers, including legacy-default and reserve goals, when a true flag is supplied. Pin the prior source for exact historical reproduction.
Task YAMLs now differ from the frozen original manifest intentionally; resolve revision 2 with this migration artifact rather than silently updating the original manifest.
No original-six completed episode was demonstrated to fail solely for HP below 1; neither frequency nor retrospective failure counts are inferred.
The retained R05 endpoint is domain evidence and a health-predicate-only replay; its full historical failure is independently established and unchanged.
No native/model/Azure/fullbenchmark work; route2 reliability remains separately owned.
Prior qualification remains tied to its source version. Revision 2 has offline checks only; 37 source-version qualifications are preserved, not certified final-ready.

retained_endpoint_replay.source_provenance_limit: Health and HUD source hashes match their recorded native source manifest. agent_protocol is a later source overlay whose full-file hash differs; the local serializer code is statically inspected, not represented as a proven exact binary build. The independent archived VM endpoint supplies runtime existence evidence.

native_domain.representation: Health.current is internal u32 fixed-point scaled by256; current() returns current/256 as f32. HealthChange.amount is f32; change_by applies native scaled fractional changes. should_die is internal current==0.
native_domain.death_protection_caveat: The native death-protection comment mentions1HP, but it does not quantize every positive living state to whole health points. Actual ended native observation has0.390625,dead=false,downed=false.
